cards.text: When David, Israel's king, is old and full of years, he installs his son Solomon as king over Israel. Then he gathers all the leaders of Israel, plus the priests and the Levites. Big meeting, friend, the kind where NOBODY is checking their phone.
With David's supplies piled up for the house of the LORD that Solomon is to build (1 Chronicles 22:6, 14), the Levite men thirty and older are counted: 38,000. That is a LOT of name tags.

cards.question: David splits the 38,000 Levites into four groups. The biggest group, 24,000 men, gets which job?

answers.text: Oversee the work of the LORD's house

cards.text: Next, 6,000 are to be officers and judges, and 4,000 are to be gatekeepers. Every great house needs somebody watching the door, friend.

cards.question: After the overseers, the officers and judges, and the gatekeepers, David has 4,000 Levites left. What does David say they are to do?
Those 4,000 Levites praise the LORD with instruments that ___ says he has made.

cards.text: Then David divides the Levites into divisions by Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and the list runs family by family, every head of a family registered by name. One standout: Aaron, brother of Moses the man of God, and Aaron's descendants are set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, burn incense before the LORD, minister before Him and pronounce blessings in His name.
Then comes what David had said, plain as day: "The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever."

cards.question: Since the LORD has come to dwell in Jerusalem, David says the Levites no longer need to ___ the tabernacle.

cards.text: No more hauling the tabernacle and all its articles around. Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer begging somebody to carry ME anywhere.
By David's final instructions, the Levites twenty years of age or older are counted. Their job is to assist with the service of the house of the LORD.

cards.question: The Levites are to assist with the service of the LORD's house. Who are they assisting?
The Levites are told to stay out of the courts and chambers of the LORD's house.

cards.text: Then the job list gets to the bread: the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering and the wafers of unleavened bread. Friend, a job list with FLOUR on it? I have never felt so seen in my life.

cards.question: The Levites also handle the baking, the mixing and all ___ of quantity and size.
On top of all that work, the Levites have a set time to stand and give thanks and praise to the LORD. When is it?

answers.text: Once a week on the Sabbath

cards.text: And whenever burnt offerings are presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons and appointed feasts, the Levites serve regularly, in the numbers set for them. Morning shift, evening shift AND holidays, friend, and that schedule does NOT come with a snooze button.

cards.question: To wrap it all up, the Levites are given responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting and the Holy Place.
